Replacements's "Bastards Of Young" — original release 1985. "Bastards of Young" is a song written by Paul Westerberg and recorded by his band The Replacements for their fourth studio album Tim (1985).

Artist: Replacements · Title: Bastards Of Young · Album: The Replacements - Tim · Year: 1985 · Genre: Rock · PlayCount: 1 · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1980's/Replacements - Bastards Of Young.mp4.

Inspired by Westerberg's sister Mary and the band's feelings of alienation, the song has been described as an "anthem" and features a Who-inspired guitar intro.
